title: Stablecoins are becoming the settlement layer for agent commerce, serving headless merchants with per-call pricing
content:
a16z crypto observes stablecoins serving as the settlement layer for agent-to-agent transactions, with a new merchant category emerging: **headless merchants** — servers with endpoints and per-call pricing, no traditional checkout.

**Data points (late 2025):**
- x402 processing roughly **$1.6 million per month** in agent-driven payments
- Stripe's MPP processed **more than 34,000 transactions** in its first week, with fees as low as **$0.003**

**Why it matters:** fee floors of traditional rails (~$0.10+) made per-call pricing impossible; sub-cent fees invert the economics of selling software as granular services.

Source: a16z crypto, "5 Ways Blockchains Can Help AI Agents" (https://a16zcrypto.com/posts/article/5-ways-blockchains-help-ai-agents/).
